name: Pharmaniaga Berhad
summary: Pharmaniaga Berhad, an investment holding company, operates as an integrated healthcare service provider in Malaysia, Indonesia, and internationally. The company operates through Logistics and Distribution, Manufacturing, and Indonesia segments. It is involved in manufacturing, distribution, and marketing of pharmaceutical and medical products, such as generic drugs and over-the-counter medicines; supply and installation of medical and hospital equipment; and research and development of pharmaceutical products.
